beh.4d-hautverjuengung.desc: A combination of several laser techniques that addresses the surface of the skin and its deeper layers in one course of treatment. How pronounced the result is varies from person to person.
beh.4d-hautverjuengung.name: 4D Skin Rejuvenation
beh.achselaufhellung.desc: Treatment of darkened underarm areas. With darker skin types there is an increased risk of lasting changes in pigmentation.
beh.achselaufhellung.name: Underarm Lightening
beh.allgemeinchirurgie.desc: General surgical procedures at the clinic centre.
beh.allgemeinchirurgie.name: General Surgery
beh.anaesthesiologie.desc: Anaesthesia and medical monitoring during surgical procedures at the clinic.
beh.anaesthesiologie.name: Anaesthesiology and Intensive Care
beh.augenbrauen-botox.desc: Gently raises the brow area and opens up the eyes, entirely without surgery.
beh.augenbrauen-botox.name: Brow Lift with Botox
beh.augenbrauentransplantation.desc: Rebuilds the eyebrows with your own hair.
beh.augenbrauentransplantation.name: Eyebrow Transplant
beh.augenringe-filler.desc: Softens shadows and tear troughs beneath the eyes for a more rested look.
beh.augenringe-filler.name: Under-Eye Filler
beh.barthaartransplantation.desc: Adds density to the beard and its contours with your own follicles from the back of the head. The transplanted hairs usually remain permanently.
beh.barthaartransplantation.name: Beard Transplant
beh.bauchdeckenstraffung.desc: Tightens skin and tissue on the abdomen, often after pregnancy or significant weight loss.
beh.bauchdeckenstraffung.name: Tummy Tuck (Abdominoplasty)
beh.bbl-lichttherapie.desc: Broadband light therapy for redness, pigmentation and early fine lines.
beh.bbl-lichttherapie.name: BBL Light Therapy
beh.besenreiser-couperose.desc: Seals fine visible veins on the legs and in the face.
beh.besenreiser-couperose.name: Thread Vein and Rosacea Treatment
beh.bleaching.desc: Professional tooth whitening carried out at the clinic.
beh.bleaching.name: Teeth Whitening
beh.botox-achseln.desc: Reduces excessive underarm sweating for several months. The effect then wears off again.
beh.botox-achseln.name: Botox for Underarm Sweating
beh.botox-haende.desc: Reduces excessive sweating of the palms for several months. The effect then wears off again.
beh.botox-haende.name: Botox for Sweaty Hands
beh.brauenlifting-schlaefenstraffung.des: Lifts the brows and temple area and opens up the eye region.
beh.bruststraffung.desc: Restores shape and support to the breast, for example after breastfeeding or weight loss.
beh.bruststraffung.name: Breast Lift
beh.brustvergroesserung.desc: With an implant or your own fat. Which method suits you is decided during the consultation.
beh.brustvergroesserung.name: Breast Augmentation
beh.check-up.desc: A comprehensive health examination for early detection, including a blood count and further tests.
beh.check-up.name: Medical Check-Up
beh.chemisches-peeling.desc: Removes the uppermost layer of skin in a controlled way. Depending on the depth, a phase of peeling follows; with darker skin types there is a risk of changes in pigmentation.
beh.chemisches-peeling.name: Chemical Peel
beh.dehnungsstreifen-pigmentflecken.desc: Treatment of stretch marks and pigmentation spots with laser and active ingredients. Older, white stretch marks respond considerably less well than fresh, reddish ones.
beh.dehnungsstreifen-pigmentflecken.name: Stretch Mark and Pigmentation Treatment
beh.dermatologie.desc: Specialist assessment and treatment of skin conditions.
beh.dermatologie.name: Dermatology
beh.dhi-haartransplantation.desc: Direct implantation with the Choi pen for particularly dense results.
beh.dhi-haartransplantation.name: DHI Hair Transplant
beh.eigenfett-transfer.desc: Moves your own body fat to where volume is wanted.
beh.eigenfett-transfer.name: Fat Transfer (Lipofilling)
beh.ernaehrungsberatung.name: Nutritional Counselling and Dietetics
beh.facelifting.desc: Tightens the face and neck and restores clear contours.
beh.facelifting.name: Facelift
beh.fadenlifting.desc: Lifts sagging areas of the face with dissolvable threads. The effect lasts around one to one and a half years; it does not remove pronounced excess skin.
beh.fadenlifting.name: Thread Lift (French Lift)
beh.fettabsaugung.desc: Removes stubborn fat deposits and contours individual areas of the body.
beh.fettabsaugung.name: Liposuction
beh.fettweg-mesotherapie.desc: An injection treatment for small, stubborn pockets of fat. It replaces neither weight loss nor liposuction; the effect varies from person to person and cannot be demonstrated in everyone treated.
beh.fettweg-mesotherapie.name: Slimming and Fat-Dissolving Mesotherapy
beh.feuermal-behandlung.desc: Laser treatment of port wine stains over several sessions. How much a port wine stain lightens varies greatly from person to person; complete removal is usually not possible.
beh.feuermal-behandlung.name: Port Wine Stain Treatment
beh.fraktionierter-laser.desc: Treats the skin point by point and stimulates collagen formation. The result builds up over months and varies from person to person.
beh.fraktionierter-laser.name: Fractional Laser Treatment
beh.fue-haartransplantation.desc: Individual extraction of hair follicles, the established standard method.
beh.fue-haartransplantation.name: FUE Hair Transplant
beh.g5-cellulite-massage.desc: A device-assisted massage treatment intended to stimulate circulation and lymph flow. A lasting effect on cellulite has not been demonstrated.
beh.g5-cellulite-massage.name: G5 Cellulite Massage
beh.gefaessveraenderungen.desc: Laser treatment of haemangiomas and other vascular lesions.
beh.gefaessveraenderungen.name: Laser Treatment of Vascular Lesions
beh.gesichts-botox.desc: Treatment of expression lines across the whole face, dosed for a natural result.
beh.gesichts-botox.name: Full-Face Botox
beh.gesichts-mesolifting.desc: Active-ingredient injections intended to hydrate the skin. The firming effect is limited and varies from person to person.
beh.gesichts-mesolifting.name: Facial Mesolift
beh.gesichtsverjuengung-filler.desc: Skin boosters distribute fine hyaluronic acid deposits across the face and improve skin quality.
beh.gesichtsverjuengung-filler.name: Skin Boosters / Facial Rejuvenation Filler
beh.gesundheitsatteste.desc: Medical reports and certificates relating to your own treatment, for instance on fitness to travel or as a report for the doctor providing your follow-up care in Switzerland.
beh.gesundheitsatteste.name: Health Certificates and Reports
beh.gynaekologie.name: Gynaecology and Obstetrics
beh.haar-mesotherapie.desc: Injection of active ingredients into the scalp, intended to support weakened hair roots. The effect is not established.
beh.haar-mesotherapie.name: Hair Mesotherapy
beh.haar-prp.desc: An injection treatment with prepared autologous blood, intended to support weakened hair roots. It does not work for everyone and is no substitute for a hair transplant.
beh.haar-prp.name: PRP Hair Treatment
beh.haaraufhellung.desc: A laser treatment that lightens fine body hair instead of removing it. The result varies from person to person.
beh.haaraufhellung.name: Laser Hair Lightening
beh.haarpigmentierung.desc: The look of added density through medical pigmentation of the scalp.
beh.haarpigmentierung.name: Scalp Micropigmentation
beh.haartransplantation-frauen.desc: Procedures tailored specifically to female hair loss.
beh.haartransplantation-frauen.name: Hair Transplantation for Women
beh.hifu-facelifting.desc: Tightens the face and neck with focused ultrasound, without a scalpel. It works on early sagging; it does not remove pronounced excess skin.
beh.hifu-facelifting.name: Non-Surgical Facelift (HIFU)
beh.hno.desc: Ear, nose and throat medicine, including alongside rhinoplasty.
beh.hno.name: Ear, Nose and Throat Medicine
beh.hollywood-smile.desc: The complete smile from a single source: shape, shade and alignment in one treatment plan.
beh.hollywood-smile.name: Hollywood Smile
beh.hydrafacial.desc: Deep cleansing, exfoliation and active-ingredient infusion in a single treatment.
beh.hydrafacial.name: HydraFacial
beh.innere-medizin.desc: Assessments and check-ups in internal medicine.
beh.innere-medizin.name: Internal Medicine
beh.intimaufhellung.desc: Discreet laser treatment of darker areas of skin in the intimate area. With darker skin types there is an increased risk of lasting changes in pigmentation.
beh.intimaufhellung.name: Intimate Area Lightening
beh.jawline-filler.desc: Defines the chin and jaw contour for a clearer profile.
beh.jawline-filler.name: Jawline and Chin Filler
beh.karbon-peeling.desc: A laser peel with activated charcoal for a clearer, more refined complexion.
beh.karbon-peeling.name: Carbon Peel
beh.komplementaermedizin.desc: Complementary methods from traditional and complementary medicine alongside conventional medicine.
beh.komplementaermedizin.name: Traditional and Complementary Medicine
beh.kronen-veneers.desc: Ceramic shells and crowns for the shape and shade of your teeth.
beh.kronen-veneers.name: Crowns and Veneers
beh.kryolipolyse.desc: Cold treatment of small, stubborn pockets of fat. It is no substitute for weight loss; the effect varies from person to person.
beh.kryolipolyse.name: Cryolipolysis (Fat Freezing)
beh.labor.desc: Laboratory diagnostics for blood values and further tests as part of treatment preparation.
beh.labor.name: Laboratory Diagnostics
beh.lachs-dna-serum.desc: An injection treatment with polynucleotides from salmon, intended to bind moisture and stimulate the skin. In Switzerland the preparations are not licensed as medicinal products for this use; the effect varies from person to person.
beh.lachs-dna-serum.name: Salmon DNA Serum (Polynucleotides)
beh.laser-faltenbehandlung.desc: Laser treatment of fine lines and of the skin's texture. Several sessions are usual; deep wrinkles cannot be removed with it.
beh.laser-faltenbehandlung.name: Laser Wrinkle Treatment
beh.laser-haarentfernung.desc: Long-term hair reduction on the face and body. Several sessions are required; light, red and grey hairs barely respond at all.
beh.laser-haarentfernung.name: Laser Hair Removal
beh.laser-hautaufhellung.desc: Laser treatment of darker areas of skin to match them to the surrounding skin tone. With darker skin types there is an increased risk of lasting changes in pigmentation.
beh.laser-hautaufhellung.name: Laser Skin Lightening
beh.laser-pigmentflecken.desc: Treats age spots and sun spots in a targeted way. Several sessions may be required, and spots can return with sun exposure.
beh.laser-pigmentflecken.name: Laser Pigmentation Treatment
beh.laser-tattooentfernung.desc: Removes tattoos step by step over several sessions. Not all colours can be removed completely; light and green pigments often respond poorly.
beh.laser-tattooentfernung.name: Laser Tattoo Removal
beh.lidstraffung.desc: Removes excess skin from the upper or lower eyelids for a more alert look.
beh.lidstraffung.name: Eyelid Surgery (Blepharoplasty)
beh.lippen-botox.desc: Relaxes the fine lines around the mouth, known as barcode lines.
beh.lippen-botox.name: Lip Botox (Barcode Lines)
beh.lippen-filler.desc: Shapes and defines the lips with hyaluronic acid, from subtle volume to a clear contour.
beh.lippen-filler.name: Lip Fillers
beh.lymphdrainage.desc: A gentle massage that supports lymph flow and recovery.
beh.lymphdrainage.name: Lymphatic Drainage
beh.masseter-botox.desc: Relaxes the chewing muscle, for instance in cases of teeth grinding, and can make the face appear slimmer.
beh.masseter-botox.name: Masseter Botox (Jaw)
beh.medizinische-hautpflege.desc: A professional care treatment, matched to your skin type.
beh.medizinische-hautpflege.name: Medical Skincare
beh.mesotherapie-gesicht.desc: Vitamin and hyaluronic acid compounds, delivered finely into the skin.
beh.mesotherapie-gesicht.name: Mesotherapy for Facial Rejuvenation
beh.microneedling-rf.desc: Combines microneedling with radiofrequency in order to stimulate collagen formation. Several sessions are usual; the result varies from person to person.
beh.microneedling-rf.name: Gold Microneedling with Radiofrequency (Scarlet X)
beh.nasen-filler.desc: Evens out small irregularities of the nose without surgery.
beh.nasen-filler.name: Non-Surgical Nose Reshaping
beh.nasenkorrektur.desc: Reshapes the nose and, where needed, also improves breathing. One of the most frequent procedures at our partner clinic.
beh.nasenkorrektur.name: Rhinoplasty (Nose Surgery)
beh.nasolabial-filler.desc: Gently cushions the folds between the nose and the corners of the mouth.
beh.nasolabial-filler.name: Nasolabial Fold Filler
beh.oberarmstraffung.desc: Removes excess skin from the upper arms.
beh.oberarmstraffung.name: Arm Lift (Brachioplasty)
beh.oberschenkelstraffung.name: Thigh Lift
beh.ohrenkorrektur.desc: Sets prominent ears closer to the head. The result is usually permanent; a partial return of individual parts of the ear does occur.
beh.ohrenkorrektur.name: Ear Correction (Otoplasty)
beh.orthopaedie-traumatologie.desc: Specialist assessment and treatment of bones, joints and muscles.
beh.orthopaedie-traumatologie.name: Orthopaedics and Traumatology
beh.penis-eigenfett.desc: Volume build-up with your own fatty tissue. Part of the transferred fat is broken down again; the result cannot be predicted and a correction is demanding.
beh.penis-eigenfett.name: Penile Fat Transfer (Stem Shot)
beh.penis-prp.desc: An injection treatment with prepared autologous blood. There is no proof of efficacy for this application; a urological assessment is a prerequisite.
beh.penis-prp.name: Penile PRP Treatment
beh.penisvergroesserung.desc: Surgical enlargement of length or girth, following a detailed consultation with a specialist.
beh.penisvergroesserung.name: Penis Enlargement
beh.penisverkruemmung.desc: Surgical correction of a congenital or acquired curvature.
beh.penisverkruemmung.name: Correction of Penile Curvature
beh.perkutane-haartransplantation.desc: Percutaneous technique for a natural direction of growth.
beh.perkutane-haartransplantation.name: Percutaneous Hair Transplant
beh.physiotherapie.name: Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation
beh.prp-vampirlifting.desc: An injection treatment with prepared autologous blood, intended to stimulate the skin's renewal. The evidence from studies is inconsistent; some of those treated do not respond.
beh.prp-vampirlifting.name: PRP Treatment (Vampire Lift)
beh.q-switch-laser.desc: A precise laser for pigmentation spots and tattoo removal.
beh.q-switch-laser.name: Q-Switch Laser Treatment
beh.radiofrequenz.desc: A treatment with controlled deep heat, intended to stimulate collagen formation. The firming effect is limited and builds up over weeks.
beh.radiofrequenz.name: Radiofrequency Treatment
beh.radiologie.desc: Diagnostic imaging such as X-rays for assessment before and after treatments.
beh.radiologie.name: Radiology and Imaging
beh.saphir-haartransplantation.desc: FUE with sapphire blades for finer channels and faster healing.
beh.saphir-haartransplantation.name: Sapphire FUE Hair Transplant
beh.schamlippenkorrektur.desc: Correction of the inner labia, discreetly advised on and carried out.
beh.schamlippenkorrektur.name: Labiaplasty
beh.skinbooster-jungbrunnen.desc: Fine hyaluronic acid deposits that bind moisture in the skin. It mainly improves the skin's hydration; it is no substitute for a firming procedure.
beh.skinbooster-jungbrunnen.name: Fountain-of-Youth Injection (Skin Booster)
beh.smart-filler.desc: A combined filler technique, matched to the individual structure of the face.
beh.smart-filler.name: Smart Filler
beh.stammzellen-therapie.desc: An injection treatment with preparations intended to stimulate the skin's renewal. For aesthetic applications the effect is not supported by robust studies and varies from person to person.
beh.stammzellen-therapie.name: Stem Cell Skin Therapy
beh.stirn-botox.desc: Smooths forehead lines with precisely placed botulinum toxin injections. A short treatment with no downtime.
beh.stirn-botox.name: Forehead Botox
beh.stosswellentherapie.desc: Non-surgical shockwave treatment (ESWT). Its efficacy for this application is not established; a urological assessment is a prerequisite.
beh.stosswellentherapie.name: Shockwave Therapy (ESWT)
beh.urologie.name: Urology
beh.venushuegel-korrektur.desc: Contours the mons pubis surgically or by liposuction.
beh.venushuegel-korrektur.name: Mons Pubis Correction
beh.wangen-filler.desc: Restores contour and volume to the cheeks and cheekbones.
beh.wangen-filler.name: Cheek and Cheekbone Filler
beh.wurzelbehandlung.desc: Treatment of the inflamed root canal with the aim of preserving the tooth. Whether this succeeds depends on the findings.
beh.wurzelbehandlung.name: Root Canal Treatment
beh.zahnfuellungen.name: Dental Fillings
beh.zahnimplantate.desc: Replace missing teeth with a root firmly anchored in the jaw. With good care and regular check-ups they last many years.
beh.zahnimplantate.name: Dental Implants
beh.zahnprothesen.name: Dentures
beh.zahnreinigung.desc: Professional cleaning and removal of tartar.
beh.zahnreinigung.name: Professional Dental Cleaning
footer.bottom.hinweis: ETA is a referral agency and does not itself provide any medical services.
footer.tagline: Your agency for beauty treatments in Istanbul, with support from Switzerland, Austria and Germany.

kat.haartransplantation.teaser: FUE, DHI and sapphire technique, for beard and eyebrows too.

seite.agb.abschnitt.4.text: Clients are obliged to provide health-related information completely and truthfully and to follow the clinic's pre-treatment and aftercare instructions.

seite.datenschutz.abschnitt.2.text: When you make an enquiry, we process the contact and health data you provide exclusively for the purpose of advising on and arranging your treatment. Health data is particularly sensitive personal data and is treated confidentially.
seite.datenschutz.abschnitt.3.text: If you contact us via WhatsApp, the data protection terms of WhatsApp (Meta) apply in addition. For sensitive information, you are welcome to use the form or email instead.
seite.datenschutz.abschnitt.4.text: In order to prepare your treatment, we pass on relevant information to the partner clinic you have chosen, including abroad (Turkey). Information is passed on only to the extent that this is necessary for the treatment.
seite.datenschutz.abschnitt.5.text: You have the right to information about, correction of and deletion of your data. To exercise these rights, please contact
seite.finanzierung.1.text: The treatment price in three part payments, interest-free with a fixed processing fee. The first instalment secures your appointment.
seite.finanzierung.2.titel: Instalment plan with a fixed term
seite.finanzierung.3.text: You save up at your own pace with regular part payments. As soon as the amount is reached, your appointment is confirmed.
seite.finanzierung.cta.sub: We will work your plan out for you, with no obligation.
seite.finanzierung.text: Your preferred appointment should not fail because of the timing. Three models are available; which one suits you is something we clarify together during the consultation.
seite.glossar.cta.sub: Ask us — we will explain it to you.
seite.glossar.text: Technical words that appear in quotations and on treatment pages — here in plain language. Knowing the terms is what makes quotations comparable. The explanations are general and replace no medical consultation.
seite.gutzuwissen.cta.sub: We reply personally, usually the same day.
seite.gutzuwissen.cta.titel: Was your question not among them?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.1.antwort: Yes, very gladly. Many of our clients travel as a pair. Your companion attends the consultation at the clinic and is accommodated at the hotel.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.1.frage: May I bring someone with me?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.2.antwort: That depends on the treatment, from a day visit to around a week. The exact duration is stated in your personal quotation.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.2.frage: How long will I stay in Istanbul?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.3.antwort: Your support from ETA runs in German, English, Turkish or Arabic, entirely as you prefer. At the partner clinic you are likewise accompanied in your own language.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.3.frage: In which language will I be looked after?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.4.antwort: The specialist doctors of our partner clinic in Istanbul. A personal consultation and preliminary examination take place before every treatment.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.4.frage: Who will operate on or treat me?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.5.antwort: Your quotation is a fixed price from the clinic and covers the treatment, airport transfers and hotel. You book the flight yourself; we are happy to help if you wish.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.5.frage: What is included in the price?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.6.antwort: The follow-up check takes place with our partner Riverside Beauty in the Rhine Valley, in direct coordination with the clinic in Istanbul.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.6.frage: How does aftercare in Switzerland work?
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.7.antwort: Appointments can be rescheduled free of charge up to 72 hours beforehand. The details are governed by your booking confirmation.
seite.gutzuwissen.faq.7.frage: What happens if I have to reschedule my appointment?

seite.impressum.abschnitt.2.text: ETA is a referral agency for aesthetic and medical treatments at partner clinics abroad. ETA does not itself provide any medical services. The contracting party for the treatment is the respective clinic.
